findings.highlight: "And I said I already prepared it. If you've got the time, then you can go to the living room and bring back the bento I made this morning!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「だからその準備をしてるんだって。暇なら居間に行って、朝作っておいた弁当を持ってきてくれ」
findings.governingReading: その準備をしてる refers to the ongoing lunch setup including the three cushions; only then does he mention the bento made that morning.
findings.explanation: Current preparation becomes a claim he already said the meal was ready.

findings.highlight: ...our stomachs growl, signaling that we're both hungry.
findings.evidenceJa: お腹が減ったぞ、と言わんばかりの音が鳴った。
findings.governingReading: A sound announces hunger without assigning it to both people. The next line recalls either one's stomach as the usual cue, and Saber reacts.
findings.explanation: An unspecified hungry stomach sound becomes both stomachs growling.

findings.highlight: "Oh right. We always let out stomachs growling be our meal alarm. No wonder it seemed weird."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、そうか。いつもはどっちかの腹の虫で時間を確かめてたんだっけ。どうりでおかしいと思った」
findings.governingReading: The stomach cue is the usual way of noticing lunch time.
findings.explanation: Our stomachs is malformed as out stomachs.
